heroTitle: Creating a more just and joy-filled world FOR ALL
heroBody: Just Joy Collective works with people in social justice, human rights and mission-based agencies — developing self and social awareness, process design skills, and technology for social change.
heroQuote: Justice, peace and a joy filled world can be achieved through collaboration rather than competition, dialogue rather than debate.
missionTitle: Deep conversation is where every engagement begins
missionBody:
We believe that strategic and sustained partnerships, a systems view and an integrated approach support better cultural shifts. Active participation and application of new learnings to personal and local contexts brings about personal and collective transformation.

Just Joy Collective works with faith-based communities, NGOs and NFPs, and has a personal commitment to supporting organisations working with women, girls and children in situations of marginalisation.

testimonials.quote: As I leave this workshop I feel energised because it was such a well facilitated process. I am keen to sharpen the focus of my work. My heart space has been opened.
I feel confident, inspired and energized because I can apply all the things I learned from this course into my current and future ministry and really to the whole aspect of my life.

I feel informed, equipped and inspired to keep developing my capability in online communication. Moreover, I am energised by the opportunities this platform offers for creating deep, formative, human encounters online.
